tools.name: aside_memory
tools.description: Explicit account-bound read-only Aside memory retrieval and bounded untrusted historical quotations. No implicit profile, writes, hooks or extra model calls. Finite screening is not a privacy guarantee.

query.description: Non-sensitive task query: 1–300 Unicode scalar values, at most 1200 UTF-8 bytes; no controls or leading option syntax.

account.description: Explicit account routing; otherwise only GJC_ASIDE_MEMORY_ACCOUNT is consulted.
